def list_split(lst, n):
    # Calculate the number of groups needed based on n and length of lst
    num_groups = (len(lst) + n - 1) // n
    
    # Initialize a list to hold the split lists
    result = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Populate each group with elements from lst, cycling through groups
    for i, element in enumerate(lst):
        result[i % n].append(element)
    
    return [group for group in result if group]  # Filter out any empty groups
